title: Sales Data Deduplication and Analysis
task_prompt:
You have received a raw sales dataset that needs to be cleaned, deduplicated, and analyzed. The data contains duplicate transactions, missing customer information, and inconsistent formatting.

Your tasks:
1. Read the raw sales data and identify duplicate transactions (same transaction_id)
2. Remove duplicate transactions, keeping only the first occurrence
3. Fill in missing customer information where possible based on transaction patterns
4. Create a cleaned dataset with all duplicates removed
5. Generate a pivot table summarizing total sales by category and region
6. Create a pivot table showing total sales by salesperson
7. Generate a pivot table showing average order value by city
8. Create at least 2 meaningful charts showing sales insights
9. Add calculation formulas to the output showing: total revenue, average order value, total transactions after deduplication

Return the cleaned data, pivot tables, chart specifications, and calculation formulas.

pivot_by_category_region.description: Total sales by category and region

formulas.name: Total Revenue
formulas.description: Sum of all sales after deduplication

formulas.name: Total Transactions
formulas.description: Count of unique transactions after deduplication
